label: Sulphur dioxide; land use regression (LUR) estimate for annual mean air pollution concentration (ug/m3) in 1971 - at age 25 years
meta_rows: Sulphur dioxide; land use regression (LUR) estimate for annual mean air pollution concentration (ug/m3) in 1971 - at age 25 years

Sulphur dioxide (SO2) maps were modelled based on a land use regression (LUR) model. BS & SO2 concentrations were modelled as part of the CHESS project (Welcome Trust funded, grant 075883). For details of the models see references Gulliver et al, 2011 (for BS & SO2) and Gulliver et al, 2013 (for NO2).
